spellbook.finance/limitations: scenario is a conditional model output in USD for inputs.boxQuantity. It is not realized proceeds, an executable quote, a guaranteed purchase ceiling or a net-profit probability. Missing pool evidence returns availability unavailable and scenario null.

A null breakevenWeek or breakevenDate means no crossing within horizonWeeks at the supplied cost and model assumptions. It does not mean never. Generated dates are projected model dates, not sales observations.

source.rankingUpdatedAt is a stored model-record clock. generatedAt dates this computation and provenance.fetchedAt dates this read. Independent provider price clocks and model revisions remain unknown.

The model uses a capped expected-card pool, modeled or listing-derived velocity and an aggregate tail overlay. Price-input finish is not retained; the pool and aggregate EV are different scopes. Market-wide velocity is not the caller's achieved sell-through.

Fee, postage, order-size, capacity and seller-mode settings are model assumptions. laborCards is a handling-count estimate using a fixed cards-per-pack assumption; no dollar labor, caller tax, financing or opportunity cost was supplied. The read does not establish current provider fee policy.
Gross N0 and single-pack breakEvenPct belong to spellbook_box_ev_rankings. They do not provide a box-level after-cost loss distribution or the cash-recovery date returned by this scenario.

annotations.title: Model a sealed product's cash recovery

description: Read the existing cash-recovery scenario for one exact sealed product and caller-supplied total cost. Use it for modeled after-cost recovery and break-even timing, separately from gross opening EV or a probability of profit. Resolve the numeric product id with spellbook_sealed_product_search first. Returns the supplied assumptions, quantity, model horizon, source coverage, USD results and unknown clocks. Read the returned guideResourceUri for interpreting conditional price ceilings and a missing crossing. This read does not select a purchase price or recommend opening a product.

boxQuantity.description: Quantity of the exact sealed product, from 1 to 10000. Results are totals for this quantity, not per box. Defaults to one.

costBasisUsd.description: Positive caller-assumed total acquisition cost in USD for the entire requested quantity, including any inbound costs the caller chooses. Required; no catalog-price default.

sellerMode.description: Existing recovery-assumption preset. It changes modeled haircuts and tail timing; it does not verify the caller's seller performance. Defaults to typical.

tcgProductId.description: Exact numeric sealed-product id from spellbook_sealed_product_search. A display, case and pack have different ids.
